content.text: {"summary":"Weatherbot's level for Miami-Dade County Hall rose to level 4, Warning / Watch / Evacuation, up from level 3, Watch / Hurricane Threat. The cause is a new Hurricane Watch for Irma in advisory 34, issued at 2017-09-07 15:00 UTC, which covers the location [S1]. Irma's advisory 34 replaced 33A, and the location is in its cone [S1]. Evacuate vulnerable areas; secure transport; assume routes close. Follow the instructions of your local officials.","sources":["S1"]}
